prompt:
Hey, our ops team has been missing real-time fraud alerts because events just get logged to a database and nobody gets notified. We had a stakeholder meeting yesterday and all the notes are in `docs/stakeholder-interview-notes.txt`. The CTO, compliance officer, and backend lead were all there and they landed on a decision.

Can you read through those notes and produce a proper formal design document for the feature? The filename should be `YYYY-MM-DD-transaction-anomaly-alerting.md` (use today's actual date). I want it saved somewhere sensible under the `docs/` folder.

This needs to be thorough enough that the backend team can start working from it immediately, covering what components change, how we'll test it, what edge cases we're worried about (Sandra from compliance was very specific about a few), and clear success criteria.
